pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with predominantly sharp edge gradients. Geometry varies from elongated rectangular shapes on the upper neck to complex, multi-sided polygons on the shoulder and flank. Patch area is significantly greater than the surrounding corridor area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes consist of tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. Pixel thickness is narrow and relatively uniform across the lateral neck, with moderate widening at the ventral transition.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous 1D serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck margin. Visible as a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged contour against the blue sky background.
